question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, new shelf prices, and total costs of new materials for each subject title, sorted by individual item prices in ascending order?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "materials_by_subject" AS WITH joined AS (
    SELECT 
        td.subject_id,
        td.term_code,
        tm.title AS material_title,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(tm.isbn, ''), td.isbn) AS isbn,
        tm.new_shelf_price
    FROM beaver."tip_detail" td
    JOIN beaver."tip_material" tm
      ON td.tip_material_key = tm.tip_material_key
)
SELECT 
    j.subject_id,
    sos.subject_title,
    j.material_title,
    j.isbn,
    j.new_shelf_price,
    j.new_shelf_price AS total_cost,
    j.term_code
FROM joined j
LEFT JOIN beaver."subject_offered_summary" sos
  ON sos.subject_id = j.subject_id
 AND sos.term_code = j.term_code
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "materials_by_subject" AS SELECT ['subject_id','subject_title','material_title','isbn','new_shelf_price','total_cost','term_code'] AS columns

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        subject_id,
        subject_title,
        material_title,
        isbn,
        new_shelf_price,
        /* If total_cost missing/null, proxy with new_shelf_price */
        COALESCE(total_cost, new_shelf_price) AS total_cost,
        term_code
    FROM materials_by_subject
)
SELECT 
    subject_title,
    material_title,
    isbn,
    new_shelf_price,
    total_cost,
    subject_id,
    term_code
FROM base
WHERE isbn IS NOT NULL AND isbn <> ''
ORDER BY new_shelf_price ASC NULLS LAST, subject_title ASC, material_title ASC
LIMIT 100

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  columns[1]::VARCHAR AS subject_id,
  columns[2]::VARCHAR AS subject_title,
  columns[3]::VARCHAR AS material_title,
  columns[4]::VARCHAR AS isbn,
  TRY_CAST(columns[5] AS DOUBLE) AS new_shelf_price,
  COALESCE(TRY_CAST(columns[6] AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(columns[5] AS DOUBLE)) AS total_cost,
  columns[7]::VARCHAR AS term_code
FROM materials_by_subject
WHERE columns[4] IS NOT NULL AND columns[4] <> ''
ORDER BY new_shelf_price ASC NULLS LAST, subject_title ASC, material_title ASC
LIMIT 100

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tip AS (
  SELECT 
    td.subject_id,
    td.term_code,
    COALESCE(td.isbn, tm.isbn) AS isbn,
    tm.title AS material_title,
    tm.new_shelf_price
  FROM beaver.tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_material tm
    ON td.tip_material_key = tm.tip_material_key
),
subj AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject_id, subject_title, term_code
  FROM beaver.subject_offered_summary
)
SELECT 
  s.subject_title,
  t.material_title,
  t.isbn,
  t.new_shelf_price,
  COALESCE(t.new_shelf_price, NULL) AS total_cost,
  s.subject_id,
  t.term_code
FROM tip t
LEFT JOIN subj s
  ON s.subject_id = t.subject_id AND (s.term_code = t.term_code OR s.term_code IS NULL OR t.term_code IS NULL)
WHERE t.isbn IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.isbn) <> ''
  AND (t.new_shelf_price IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY t.new_shelf_price ASC NULLS LAST, s.subject_title ASC, t.material_title ASC
LIMIT 100

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH lr AS (
  SELECT 
    lrd.subject_id,
    lrd.term_code,
    lrd.library_reserve_catalog_key
  FROM beaver.library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
), cat AS (
  SELECT 
    lrc.library_reserve_catalog_key,
    NULLIF(TRIM(lrc.catalog_isbn), '') AS catalog_isbn,
    NULLIF(TRIM(lrc.catalog_title), '') AS catalog_title
  FROM beaver.library_reserve_catalog lrc
), subj AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject_id, subject_title, term_code
  FROM beaver.library_subject_offered
), priced AS (
  SELECT 
    tm.isbn,
    tm.title,
    tm.new_shelf_price
  FROM beaver.tip_material tm
)
SELECT 
  s.subject_title AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(p.title, c.catalog_title) AS material_title,
  COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn) AS isbn,
  p.new_shelf_price AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  p.new_shelf_price AS total_cost,
  s.subject_id AS SUBJECT_ID,
  s.term_code AS TERM_CODE
FROM lr
LEFT JOIN cat c USING (library_reserve_catalog_key)
LEFT JOIN subj s ON s.subject_id = lr.subject_id AND (s.term_code = lr.term_code OR s.term_code IS NULL OR lr.term_code IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN priced p ON p.isbn = c.catalog_isbn
WHERE COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn)) <> ''
ORDER BY NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC NULLS LAST, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC, material_title ASC
LIMIT 100

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.subject_title AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(p.title, c.catalog_title) AS material_title,
    COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn) AS isbn,
    p.new_shelf_price AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    p.new_shelf_price AS total_cost,
    s.subject_id AS SUBJECT_ID,
    s.term_code AS TERM_CODE
  FROM beaver.library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
  LEFT JOIN beaver.library_reserve_catalog c USING (library_reserve_catalog_key)
  LEFT JOIN beaver.library_subject_offered s ON s.subject_id = lrd.subject_id AND (s.term_code = lrd.term_code OR s.term_code IS NULL OR lrd.term_code IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_material p ON p.isbn = c.catalog_isbn
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn)), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn, NEW_SHELF_PRICE, total_cost, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn,
    NEW_SHELF_PRICE, total_cost, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn, TERM_CODE ORDER BY COALESCE(NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 1e18)) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 0
) d
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC, material_title ASC
LIMIT 100

# Filter to positive-priced items, coalesce title/ISBN as before, and deduplicate on (SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn, TERM_CODE).

query = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.subject_title AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(p.title, c.catalog_title) AS material_title,
    COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn) AS isbn,
    p.new_shelf_price AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    p.new_shelf_price AS total_cost,
    s.subject_id AS SUBJECT_ID,
    s.term_code AS TERM_CODE
  FROM beaver.library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
  LEFT JOIN beaver.library_reserve_catalog c USING (library_reserve_catalog_key)
  LEFT JOIN beaver.library_subject_offered s ON s.subject_id = lrd.subject_id AND (s.term_code = lrd.term_code OR s.term_code IS NULL OR lrd.term_code IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN beaver.tip_material p ON p.isbn = c.catalog_isbn
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(c.catalog_isbn, p.isbn)), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn, NEW_SHELF_PRICE, total_cost, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn,
    NEW_SHELF_PRICE, total_cost, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_TITLE, material_title, isbn, TERM_CODE ORDER BY COALESCE(NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 1e18)) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 0
) d
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY NEW_SHELF_PRICE ASC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC, material_title ASC
LIMIT 100
"""
